verdict.rationale: Dover documents an ATS with a Kanban pipeline view and per-job interview plans. Bulk actions exist but only on the $199/month Premium tier, and nothing explicitly documents custom pipeline stages or drag-to-move. missing for 10: explicit custom per-job stage configuration, documented drag-and-drop candidate movement, bulk actions across the whole pipeline on the free tier, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, I run configurable hiring pipelines — custom stages per job, drag-to-move candidates, and bulk actions across the whole pipeline

citations.quote: Kanban view for a comprehensive overview
Set up your interview plan, schedule candidates, and collect structured feedback from every interviewer.
Premium is $199/month and adds AI applicant scoring, the AI notetaker, offer management with e-signing, bulk actions, and more.
